title: RIG-I translocation simulator
description: A one-dimensional simulation of RIG-I molecules translocating along dsRNA, pausing, and forming multi-molecule complexes, built to examine how pausing relates to filament formation (WT vs. Δ2CARD RIG-I). Includes the simulation engine, the measured HS-AFM distributions used as input, and scripts to regenerate the figures.
